gallery.filename: PFC Bernardo Blazek Stands Atop a Prime Mover, 1969 (11950952726).jpg
gallery.title: File:PFC Bernardo Blazek Stands Atop a Prime Mover, 1969 (11950952726).jpg
gallery.description:
"The Victor: Marine Private First Class Bernardo A. Blazek (Viroqua, Wisconsin) stands atop a prime mover for an enemy 122mm artillery piece captured by the 9th Marine Regiment during Operation Dewey Canyon.  The enemy destroyed two of the large artillery pieces and their prime movers while fleeing from the Leatherneck advance toward the A Shau Valley (official USMC photo by Staff Sergeant Bob Jordan)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

gallery.filename: 1st Battalion, 9th Marines Sniper Team, 1969 (11950145775).jpg
gallery.title: File:1st Battalion, 9th Marines Sniper Team, 1969 (11950145775).jpg
gallery.description:
"On Target: A Marine sniper team with 1st Battalion, 9th Marines [1/9] opens fire on the enemy while participating in Operation Dewey Canyon.  The multi-battalion offensive thrust in the jungles just northwest of the A Shau Valley netted the Marines 436 enemy killed during the first 30 days of the operation (official USMC photo by Lance Corporal D. L. Randolph)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH
categories: 1st Battalion 9th Marines in the Vietnam War

gallery.filename: Lieutenant Miles Davis Receives Promotion to First Lieutenant, 1969 (11950154535).jpg
gallery.title: File:Lieutenant Miles Davis Receives Promotion to First Lieutenant, 1969 (11950154535).jpg
gallery.description:
"Proud Father: Lieutenant Miles Davis (Alexandria, Virginia) receives his promotion to 1st Lieutenant from his father, Major General Raymond G. Davis, Commanding General, 3d Marine Division, and Colonel Robert H. Barrow (left), Commanding Officer, 9th Marine Regiment, at Fire Support Base Cunningham during Operation Dewey Canyon.  Lieutenant Davis, executive officer of K Company, 3d Battalion, 9th Marines [K/3/9], suffered minor wounds later in the operation and received his second Purple Heart since joining the unit last September (official USMC photo by Staff Sergeant F. Lowe, Jr.]."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: HMM 242 Sea Knight, 1969 (11950202855).jpg
gallery.title: File:HMM 242 Sea Knight, 1969 (11950202855).jpg
gallery.description:
"A Marine Medium Helicopter Squadron 242 [HMM-242] Sea Knight briefly perches on the landing pad of the Hospital Ship Sanctuary off the coast of Vietnam to unload Marine casualties from Operation Dewey Canyon.  Medical evacuation flights rush casualties to the ship’s medical facilities within minutes after injury (official USMC photo by Corporal Stewart MacKenzie)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

gallery.filename: Colonel James Moore and Staff Sergeant Henry Taylor, Jr., 1969 (11950235985).jpg
gallery.title: File:Colonel James Moore and Staff Sergeant Henry Taylor, Jr., 1969 (11950235985).jpg
gallery.description:
"Colonel James Moore (Denison, Texas) points out an enemy sniper position to Staff Sergeant Henry W. Taylor, Jr. (foreground) of Marshallville, Georgia.  Both are members of the 9th Marine Regiment, 3d Marine Division and are participating in Operation Dewey Canyon in the northern A Shau Valley complex (official USMC photo by Corporal J. G. McCullough)."

gallery.filename: Marines Assist a Combat Casualty Aboard a Sea Knight Helicopter, 1969 (11950680064).jpg
gallery.title: File:Marines Assist a Combat Casualty Aboard a Sea Knight Helicopter, 1969 (11950680064).jpg
gallery.description:
"Long Lift: Aircrewmen assist a combat casualty aboard a Marine Aircraft Group 39 [MAG-39] Sea Knight helicopter during an Operation Dewey Canyon medical evacuation flight.  The helicopter crew used a winch and cable to hoist the wounded Marine, from an area too overgrown for landing, to the ‘chopper’ hovering above the trees.  The Marine CH-46s, flying at more than 130 miles per hour, whisk casualties to expert medical help within minutes after pick-up (official USMC photo by Sergeant David Butler)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: Medevac Operation, 1969 (11950534533).jpg
gallery.title: File:Medevac Operation, 1969 (11950534533).jpg
gallery.description:
"Medevac: A wounded infantryman from 9th Marines is hoisted aboard a 1st Marine Aircraft Wing [1st MAW] supporting 3d Marine Division Leathernecks in Operation Dewey Canyon.  The operation, centered in the A Shau Valley complex has resulted in the capture of more than 400 tons of communist arms and ammunition (official USMC photo by Lance Corporal C. E. Sickler, Jr.)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: 2d Battalion, 9th Marines Climb a Mountain, 1969 (11950248575).jpg
gallery.title: File:2d Battalion, 9th Marines Climb a Mountain, 1969 (11950248575).jpg
gallery.description:
"Tough Climb: Leathernecks of H Company, 2d Battalion, 9th Marines, make their way up a mountain during Operation Dewey Canyon.  Elements of the 9th Marines captured the largest enemy arms cache of the Vietnam war during the operation conducted in the northern A Shau Valley complex (official USMC photo by Lance Corporal Bill Carroll)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: CH-53 Helicopter Delivers Supplies, 1969 (11950250405).jpg
gallery.title: File:CH-53 Helicopter Delivers Supplies, 1969 (11950250405).jpg
gallery.description:
"Supplies for the Troops: A ‘Heavy Hauler’ CH-53 helicopter from Marine Heavy Helicopter Squadron 462 [HMH-462] hovers above the resupply depot at Camp Evans in northern I Corps, while members of the 3d Shore Party Battalion, hook up another load of supplies.  The huge cargo transport helicopter is supporting fire bases in Operation Dewey Canyon (official USMC photo by Sergeant David Butler)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: CH-46 Sea Knight Helicopter Delivers Supplies, 1969 (11950691594).jpg
gallery.title: File:CH-46 Sea Knight Helicopter Delivers Supplies, 1969 (11950691594).jpg
gallery.description:
"Resupply: A Marine CH-46 Sea Knight helicopter from the 1st Marine Air Wing [1st MAW] delivers supplies to the 9th Marine Regiment during Operation Dewey Canyon, in which Leathernecks captured over 500 tons of enemy arms and ammunition."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: Captain Edward Riley Examines a Captured SKS, 1969 (11950546013).jpg
gallery.title: File:Captain Edward Riley Examines a Captured SKS, 1969 (11950546013).jpg
gallery.description:
"Captured SKS: Captain Edward F. Riley, 32 (South Portland, Maine), a company commander with 9th Marine Regiment, examines one of over 600 North Vietnamese Army rifles captured by men of his company during Operation Dewey Canyon.  Riley led his men on an assault of an enemy held hill to capture the weapons.  His men accounted for 30 enemy dead in unearthing the largest enemy arms cache of the Vietnam war (official USMC photo by Lance Corporal E. E. Hildreth)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: Members of 3d Battalion, 9th Marines Move up a Ridgeline, 1969 (11950692304).jpg
gallery.title: File:Members of 3d Battalion, 9th Marines Move up a Ridgeline, 1969 (11950692304).jpg
gallery.description:
"Moving Up: Men of L Company, 3d Battalion, 9th Marines [L/3/9] move up a ridgeline north of A Shau Valley during Operation Dewey Canyon (official USMC photo by Corporal Robb Straub)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

gallery.filename: 2d Lieutenant Vance Rutan Shields His Ears, 1969 (11950697394).jpg
gallery.title: File:2d Lieutenant Vance Rutan Shields His Ears, 1969 (11950697394).jpg
gallery.description:
"Mortars: Marine 2d Lieutenant Vance L. Rutan (Oswego, New York) shields his ears while Marine mortars fire on enemy positions in the northern A Shau Valley complex during Operation Dewey Canyon.  Lieutenant Vance is a member of the 9th Marine Regiment, 3d Marine Division."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: Marines Inventory an Arms Cache, 1969 (11950247145).jpg
gallery.title: File:Marines Inventory an Arms Cache, 1969 (11950247145).jpg
gallery.description:
"Taking Inventory: Two members of D Company, 1st Battalion, 9th Marines [D/1/9] count part of the huge arms cache uncovered by the company on February 27 during Operation Dewey Canyon.  The cache, believed to be the largest ever uncovered in Vietnam, was found in the northern A Shau Valley complex."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: Assault of Tiger Mountain, 1969 (11950702554).jpg
gallery.title: File:Assault of Tiger Mountain, 1969 (11950702554).jpg
gallery.description:
"On the Move: Leathernecks of L Company, 3d Battalion, 9th Marines move out during the assault of Tiger Mountain north of the Ashau Valley.  The 9th Marines were participating in Operation Dewey Canyon (official USMC photo by Corporal Robb Straub)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: Captain Edward Riley Inspects an Enemy Grenade, 1969 (11950705994).jpg
gallery.title: File:Captain Edward Riley Inspects an Enemy Grenade, 1969 (11950705994).jpg
gallery.description:
"Enemy Grenade: Captain Edward F. Riley (South Portland, Maine), commanding officer of D Company, 1st Battalion, 9th Marines [1/9], holds an enemy grenade as he makes a radio report on the North Vietnamese Army arms and munitions cache his men found on February 27 during Operation Dewey Canyon.  The cache, totaling over 350 tons, was found in the northern A Shau Valley complex and is one of the biggest ever found in Vietnam."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: Captured Rifles, 1969 (11950552543).jpg
gallery.title: File:Captured Rifles, 1969 (11950552543).jpg
gallery.description:
"Stacks and Stacks of Rifles: Infantrymen of the 9th Marines inspect some of the 606 enemy rifles captured near the Laotian border during Operation Dewey Canyon.  The rifles were part of a 288 ton cache unearthed February 28 (official USMC photo by Lance Corporal E. E. Hildreth)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: Marines Inspect a North Vietnamese Antiaircraft Gun, 1969 (11951101156).jpg
gallery.title: File:Marines Inspect a North Vietnamese Antiaircraft Gun, 1969 (11951101156).jpg
gallery.description:
"Close Look: Three Marines of D Company, 1st Battalion, 9th Marines [D/1/9] look over a captured North Vietnamese Army 7.62mm antiaircraft machine gun.  The weapon was part of an arms cache believed to be the largest ever found in Vietnam.  The Marines are (left to right) Private First Class Edward F. Culp, 20 (Dayton, Ohio), 2d Lieutenant John E. Trapp (Laconia, New Hampshire), and Lance Corporal Val Fisher, 20 (Holt, California)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.filename: Marines Move Up Tiger Mountain, 1969 (11950714534).jpg
gallery.title: File:Marines Move Up Tiger Mountain, 1969 (11950714534).jpg
gallery.description:
"Moving Up: Marine infantrymen of the 3d Battalion, 9th Marines move up a battle scarred slope during Operation Dewey Canyon in the northern A Shau Valley complex.  Leathernecks advancing against the enemy held mountain top near the Laotian border dubbed the hill ‘Tiger Mountain’ (official USMC photo by Corporal J. G. McCullough)."
From the Jonathan F. Abel Collection (COLL/3611), Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections, Quantico, Virginia

OFFICIAL USMC PHOTOGRAPH

gallery.title: File:Marines are Resupplied with Water, 1969 (11950715534).jpg
gallery.description:
"Water Jugs: Leathernecks of the 9th Marines prepare to pick up water after being resupplied during Operation Dewey Canyon in the mountainous jungles of the northern A Shau Valley complex."
